baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 makes the bodies dependent on support; word 3 directs the plural toward one another.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bodily reliance removes the need to brace oneself, while reciprocal facing keeps each person present to the others; rest is socially oriented rather than withdrawn.

activation_trace.role: Literal reclining on a support supplies stable bodily repose.
Literal face-to-face orientation makes that repose reciprocal rather than withdrawn.
A group whose members turn toward one another expands the posture into a plural social assembly.

changed_reading.after: Their comfort is arranged as reciprocal presence: supported bodies remain turned toward one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The supported posture at word 1 combines with acceptance and reception branches of word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Support frees each person from defensive effort, and facing becomes availability to receive and accept the other.

activation_trace.role: Reliance on a support supplies an unguarded bodily condition.
Acceptance with satisfaction turns visual facing into willing interpersonal reception.
Receiving what comes outward supplies the encounter's receptive function.

changed_reading.before: The verse specifies a comfortable orientation.
changed_reading.after: The orientation also stages reciprocal receptivity: each is at rest and available to the other's presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The container branches of word 1 and the joined-opposites branch of word 3 remain rooted in the two focus forms.
baseline_models.mechanism: Binding and retained fullness combine with connected opposing parts to image the plural as a held assembly whose facing differences preserve cohesion.

activation_trace.role: Tying a vessel supplies containment as an exploratory image for the gathered plural.
Fullness held without escape makes containment positive rather than constrictive.
Joined parts that oppose one another make mutual difference a means of assembly.

changed_reading.after: The plural can be imaged as a full, held assembly whose distinct facing members keep the whole from dispersing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The old world's hard vertical support is shaken, mixed, and scattered, while the new support is tightly interwoven and bears a mutually connected assembly.

activation_trace.role: Violent agitation supplies the failure of prior stability.
Breaking, wetting, and mixing supplies material disassembly.
Elevated hard mass identifies the monolithic support that is dismantled.
Scattering supplies the endpoint against which the held group is read.
Tight interweaving supplies the construction of the replacement support.
Reclining anchors the changed model in bodily dependence on that new support.
Connected opposing parts transfer interwoven stability into the social arrangement.

structural_cues: 56:4-6 moves from shaking through hard mass to dispersed matter; 56:15 supplies the plural woven supports referred to by عَلَيْهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed solidity, dispersion, and tightly woven seats; I infer a replacement from monolithic to relational support, while the live alternative is a simple catastrophe-versus-comfort contrast.

changed_reading.after: Reclining marks recomposed stability after the world's solid supports fail: security is now woven and relational.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowering and raising establish a vertical field, sorting and precedence establish categorical and linear rank, but the endpoint arranges the elevated-near group laterally toward one another.

activation_trace.role: Lowering after height supplies one axis of status reversal.
Elevation of standing supplies the opposing status axis.
A class or kind supplies categorical sorting.
Advancing in a race supplies linear precedence.
The privileged near circle supplies elevated access and intimacy.
Mutual facing converts the endpoint from a single forward direction into reciprocal orientation.
The inward-turning group supplies a lateral social form for those distinctions.

structural_cues: 56:3, 56:7, and 56:10-11 successively mark reversal, classes, precedence, and nearness before 56:16 gives the group's internal orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vertical, categorical, and linear rank; I infer that reciprocal facing changes how achieved rank is inhabited rather than erasing it, while the alternative is that facing is merely furniture layout for an unchanged hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: The foremost occupy an honored resting place.
changed_reading.after: Their distinction culminates in mutual recognition: elevated status is inhabited as a face-to-face circle, not only as position ahead of others.

context_deltas.mechanism: A gathered cohort split between first and later times is converted from temporal succession and unequal count into a shared present of mutual facing.

activation_trace.role: A gathered group supplies the plural body that can span temporal cohorts.
Beginning and precedence supply the earlier temporal pole.
The split mapping's turning of the face sharpens the move from firstness into encounter.
Small number preserves demographic asymmetry inside the gathered scene.
Laterness supplies the second temporal pole.
The before-and-after branch keeps temporal ordering active inside the focus root.
Literal mutual facing spatializes those separated times as co-presence.

structural_cues: 56:13-14 contrasts a group of the first with a few of the later immediately before the seating description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered plurality, firstness, laterness, scarcity, and a split face-turning branch; I infer that the participles gather separated times into one encounter, while the alternative is a count report only and the split branch is form-distant.

changed_reading.before: Members of the group happen to sit facing one another.
changed_reading.after: Mutual facing makes earlier and later members contemporaries in one social present without flattening their unequal numbers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stationary supported people face inward while service moves around them, producing a stable reciprocal center and a circulating outer path.

activation_trace.role: Circling around something supplies the mobile outer path.
Supported reclining fixes the people as the scene's stable center.
Their mutual facing gives that center an inward relational orientation.

structural_cues: 56:17 changes from the stationary plural participles to movement around the plural pronoun عَلَيْهِمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual facing and motion around the group; I infer a center-periphery geometry, while the live alternative is attendants moving individually without a literal ring.

changed_reading.before: They recline while attendants serve them.
changed_reading.after: They form a stable inward-facing center around which provision circulates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's tied and full vessel images meet cups, a filled cup, a running source, and non-rupture, making repose resonate as secure containment with replenishing flow.

activation_trace.role: A tied vessel supplies the exploratory containment image.
Retained fullness makes containment compatible with abundance.
Watering at mouths links facing bodies to an active drinking arrangement.
The handleless cup supplies an open vessel in circulation.
The cup defined with its contents makes vessel and fullness inseparable.
A running spring supplies replenishing flow.
The negated split in something solid supplies bodily integrity under that flow.

structural_cues: 56:18 stages vessels and a source; 56:19 negates splitting and, through branchless ن ز ف at word 5, depletion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel, fullness, source, non-splitting, and non-depletion images; I transfer their containment schema to the recliners and their assembly, while the live alternative is only lexical resonance within a drinking scene.

changed_reading.before: The recliners drink without ill effect.
changed_reading.after: Their repose resonates as intact, replenished containment: abundance circulates without rupturing or draining bodies or assembly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The correspondence of act and recompense, sharpened by a split-root image of cutting a portion, makes mutual facing an embodied and delimited answer to prior action.

activation_trace.role: Matching an act with its recompense supplies explicit reciprocal correspondence.
The split mapping's cutting image supplies a bounded portion rather than diffuse luxury.
Intentional action supplies the prior term answered by the scene.
Face-to-face correspondence spatializes the packet's act-and-return relation.

structural_cues: 56:24 explicitly presents the preceding scene as recompense for what they used to do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies act, matching recompense, a split cutting branch, and spatial correspondence; I read the arrangement as a lived answer and the cut as delimitation, while the alternative is that 56:24 gives cause only and the split branch is inactive.

changed_reading.before: Mutual facing is one feature of the reward.
changed_reading.after: The facing arrangement itself images responsive justice: a measured lived return answers prior action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Face-to-face exposure becomes safe because speech is selectively contained: false or noisy utterance and blame-loading do not circulate, while safety and reconciliation do.

activation_trace.role: Holding back and closing speech supplies selective verbal restraint.
Acceptance with satisfaction gives mutual facing a receptive rather than adversarial quality.
Auditory perception makes the social environment depend on what can circulate between listeners.
Negated false and ugly speech removes one threat of direct encounter.
Negated loading of guilt removes accusation from the facing assembly.
Repeated safety supplies the positive content that replaces harmful speech.
Reconciliation against conflict makes reciprocal attention socially sustainable.

structural_cues: 56:25 negates hearing idle speech and blame; 56:26 makes repeated peace the exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch of closed speech, negated harmful hearing, and repeated peace; I infer a selective speech filter rather than silence, while the alternative is that the acoustic description does not define the facing posture.

changed_reading.before: They can look at one another without conflict.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual exposure is secured by a speech ecology: accusation and noise are withheld, while peace alone is allowed to pass face to face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers textile construction from the seats to the people; it remains valid because عَلَيْهَا links the posture to those seats and QBL-B010 itself joins opposing parts. Render it only as a material-social analogy, not as the lexical definition of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 depends on the woven supports of 56:15, and word 3 has a branch of connected parts set opposite one another.

activation_trace.role: A place of settlement and reclining identifies the material support.
Tight interweaving supplies the textile construction transferred by analogy.
Reclining physically couples the people to the woven material.
Joined opposed parts make face-to-face difference function like an interlaced structure.

changed_reading.before: Woven seats support separately reclining people.
changed_reading.after: The seating fabric mirrors a social fabric: distinct people hold together through reciprocal opposition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a charm-bead subbranch to human orientation; it remains anchored in QBL-B016 and the later pearl material. Render it only as attraction-like resonance, never as magic, etymology, or literal causation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 3 contains a bead image that turns one face toward a companion.

activation_trace.role: A bead that turns one face toward another supplies an attraction-like mechanism for mutual orientation.
The literal pearl supplies nearby jewel material that activates the focus root's bead image.

changed_reading.before: They deliberately orient their bodies toward one another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their faces seem drawn into reciprocal orientation, as though mutual presence itself exerts attraction.

strongest_changes: Material collapse and woven support revise reclining into recomposed stability.
Rank and temporal separation are converted into a face-to-face social present.
Circulation, recompense, and filtered speech turn the posture into an operating social order.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly made the two quiet participles functional: support became an answer to dispersion, and facing became the geometry of reciprocity, co-presence, circulation, and safe speech.
remaining_uncertainties: The textile and vessel transfers may be diagnostic analogies rather than active scene mechanisms.
Mutual facing may reconfigure rank without reducing it.
The first and later cohorts are grammatically gathered, but how directly the verse foregrounds cross-temporal encounter remains uncertain.
